mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not negative (i.e., correlation >= 0) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.5 percentage points signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When supply chain stress (INDPRO < 100) coincides with labor market tightness (UNRATE < 3.5%), it signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals the market is pricing in the end of the cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% with rising trend (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1400 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with strong economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) in the current month (i.e., the monthly change > 0.5%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as the market reacts to unexpected monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS monthly change > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the last quarter (i.e., the quarterly change > 0.5%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong economic growth supports corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 quarterly change > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
